paragraphs: Markets over the last day: the eight tracked equity indices moved +0.25% on average, with Nikkei 225 strongest (+2.33%) and Nasdaq weakest (-0.74%). Brent crude changed -0.55% to 92.06. Gold changed -1.86% to 4,038.1001. Bitcoin changed -1.98% to 73,734.3438. The US 10-year yield stands at 4.983%, a relative move of +2.45%. Among the firms tracked, Gold Miners (ETF) (-5.43%) and Newmont (-4.15%) moved the most.
